# Ruster adapter compatibility

This is published transform-gizmo-egui0.11.0, MIT OR Apache-2.0, with egui/dev-eframe dependency constraints raised0.36→0.37, `Ui::id` renamed to `Ui::scope_id`, and core resolved through `../transform-gizmo`. Exact upstream license files are retained here. Source attribution, archive/commit hashes, six-line compatibility patch and review/removal triggers are documented in `../transform-gizmo/RUSTER-PATCH.md` and its provenance record. Ruster owns editor gesture transactions/cancel/undo; the adapter does not provide document history semantics.
